title: Tests are flaky - test_slugify fails intermittently
body:
I keep seeing `tests/test_slugify.py::test_collapses_whitespace` fail, but only sometimes - re-running usually makes it pass, so I think it's an ordering or hash-seed issue rather than a real bug.

Example failure:

    assert 'hello-world' == 'hello--world'

Could someone look into why it's non-deterministic and fix it? Happy to review a PR.

- filed by a first-time contributor

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: Thanks for the report. We run CI with `-p no:randomly` so I doubt it's ordering. Please dig into the actual assertion before assuming it's flaky.
